name: court
probe: const rows=[];for(let z=-12;z<=12;z+=1){let r='';for(let x=-12;x<=12;x+=1){const y=walkY(x,z);r+=y===null?'#':(Math.abs(y)<1.5?'.':(y>0?'+':'-'));}rows.push(z+' '+r);}return rows

name: people
